_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

classification.quality_note: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.18x; +14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.96; conservative 2yr +75%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY12-FY12 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +34.1%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.6-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +34.1%/yr (no FY12-FY12 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.1%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2013-08-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.18x (14.9% downside to Bear $32 / +80.9% upside to Bull $68) | Adj composite 3.53 vs market 1.57: gap +1.96 [UNDERVALUED] | +14% above the EPP floor $33 (59x FY13E $0.56) | Conservative 2-yr case: +75.0% total (+37.5%/yr) | At 67.1x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $50 sits at or below the BASE case; segment EBDA +76.0% and Natural Gas Pipelines +235.9% in Q2 2013, forward revenues +56.1% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2013 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
